text:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: service=api-gateway edge-tier severity=critical — spike in 5xx (502/504) and timeouts across eu-west-1 and us-east-1, alert id PD-9342. Initial anomaly detected at 2026-03-15T02:12:24Z.
ryan: taking this oncall — I’m on the bridge. @emily can you grab traces/ingress logs?
emily: looking at traces now. p50 ok, p95 for edge requests rising from 180ms to 850ms, error-rate up to ~14% on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings in eu-west. Grafana: https://graf.example/r/edge-502-spike (short link)
sophie: any config pushes recently? I'm checking commit history for api-gateway and edge-proxy in the last 30m.
alex: not seeing deploys from infra in last hour. Cloudfront/Edge config change? No config invalidations.
ryan: running quick check of upstream health: `curl -I https://upstream-service.internal/health` -> timeouts intermittently.
emily: traces show timeouts before request reaches model-serving pool; connections to apiserver-backend are resetting (RST) from backend nodes. Looks like connection saturation on backend side. Sample log: ```[2026-03-15T02:13:05Z] conn_reset from 10.2.4.8: downstream_id=abc123 req=/v1/generate status=502 upstream_err=EOF```
sophie: if backend pool is saturated we should throttle at edge and enable circuit breaker to avoid head-of-line failures. Can we flip the edge-circuit-breaker to short-circuit noisy routes?
ryan: enabling circuit breaker for /v1/embeddings (low priority) and /v1/generate (degraded mode) for eu-west. Command: `rbacctl set-policy apigw --circuit-breaker /v1/embeddings --open` — applying now.
deploy-bot: policy update applied: apigw circuit-breaker /v1/embeddings = OPEN in eu-west-1 by ryan at 2026-03-15T02:15:10Z.
emily: noise down on embeddings errors to ~3% after breaker, generate still at ~9%. Backend pods CPU at 95% and concurrent connections spiking.
alex: scaling backend pool now: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy apiserver-backend --replicas=12` — started. Watching for pod readiness.
sophie: good. also increasing DB connection pool max to 350 in app config to avoid queueing (rolling restart). Patch: `kubectl set env deploy/apiserver-backend DB_MAX_CONN=350`
ryan: rolling restart in progress. ETA ~60s per pod, doing canary rotation.
emily: quick mitigation: enabling short-lived 429-based backpressure at edge for noisy tenants to reduce tail latency. Patch uploaded to edge config, activating in 30s.
csm-maya: Customer ops — we have 3 customers reporting increased errors (acme-inc, betaapp, partnerX). I’ve opened support cases and notified their CS points. ETA for status page update?
ryan: hold — let me confirm impact slice. Emily, can you pull request samples of failed requests grouped by customer?
emily: done, failures concentrated on Acme and BetaApp in eu-west. Error payloads show upstream resets; not application-level 4xx.
sophie: after second scale step pods are Ready. Backend ready count reached 12 at 02:18:40Z.
emily: error-rate fell to 2.7% in eu-west after scale + breakers + backpressure — latency p95 back to ~230ms.
ryan: great. reverting circuit breaker for embeddings to CLOSED in 10m if stable; keeping generate in DEGRADED mode for now.
ryan: updating incident state: mitigation partially successful, customer impact reduced but ongoing for some sessions. Next steps: deep-dive on why connection saturation happened (leaked keepalives? ephemeral NAT exhaustion?) and postmortem.
sophie: capturing current actions in runbook: `/runbook activate edge-502-mitigation` — notes: scale backend, enable circuit-breaker, edge backpressure, increase DB pool.
ryan: handing to emily for root cause investigation. I’m going offline in 15m for handoff. @csm-maya please post a short status on status.redwood.ai: "Partial mitigation in eu-west; some customers may still see errors. Engineering continuing investigation."
csm-maya: posting update now. (status page posted) :mega:
emily: taking over root cause. I'll correlate kernel socket stats, iptables conntrack, and app metrics. Will ping here with a RCA hypothesis in next 45m.
ryan: thanks — excellent work everyone. I'll stay on-call watch for 30m. :thumbsup:
